page_title: DAR 2-5 BAY | Darmstadt v Bayern Munich 16/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's the end of the match.
90+5' 2 - 5 Goal! After receiving a sweet pass, Oscar Vilhelmsson (Darmstadt) unleashes a shot straight inside the right post. Good team effort!
90+3' 1 - 5 Goal! Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the middle of the net. He makes it 1:5.
90+2' 6:25 – the total goal attempt statistics.
90' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.

88' OFF THE POST! Sebastian Polter (Darmstadt) drifts into the box to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from close range, but it crashes against the left post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
87' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar.
85' The foul by Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) was seen by Tobias Reichel who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
84' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. He sends the ball into orbit.
84' Bayern Munich quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
84' Emir Karic (Darmstadt) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
83' Bayern Munich take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
82' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) leaves the pitch to be replaced by Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting.
79' Torsten Lieberknecht has decided to make a change. Sebastian Polter (Darmstadt) replaces Tim Skarke.
79' Here comes a substitution. Bartol Franjic is given a rest as he is replaced by Klaus Gjasula (Darmstadt).
78' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
78' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) smashes the ball against the crossbar! What a chance.
77' Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
74' 1 - 4 Goal! Jamal Musiala tees up Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the bottom left corner. 1:4.
71' Substitution. Fabian Holland walks off the pitch and Emir Karic (Darmstadt) comes on as a substitute.
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Aaron Seydel (Darmstadt) replaces Mathias Honsak.
71' Thomas Tuchel has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) replacing Raphael Guerreiro.
71' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Serge Gnabry (Bayern Munich) is coming onto the pitch as Thomas Muller cannot continue after picking up an injury.
70' Thomas Tuchel prepares a substitution. Leroy Sane is replaced by Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich).
68' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Bayern Munich.
67' What was Bartol Franjic (Darmstadt) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
67' Good work from Bayern Munich as they win a corner.
64' 1 - 3 Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Marcel Schuhen with a strike into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:3.
62' Oscar Vilhelmsson (Darmstadt) sends a cross into the box, but Manuel Neuer comes off his line to gather the ball.
60' Bartol Franjic (Darmstadt) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Tobias Reichel saw the whole situation.
58' Problems for Thomas Tuchel as Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Konrad Laimer replaces him.
55' The Darmstadt players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
54' Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
52' Eric Dier (Bayern Munich) is able to continue to play.
51' Eric Dier (Bayern Munich) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
50' Torsten Lieberknecht is forced to make a change. Christoph Klarer (Darmstadt) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Christoph Zimmermann.
49' Christoph Klarer (Darmstadt) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
48' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Oscar Vilhelmsson (Darmstadt) latches onto a good pass inside the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper, but deflects off the crossbar to safety.

45+1' 1 - 2 It's a goal! Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) makes it 1:2. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Joshua Kimmich and planted his close-range header into the left side of the goal. Marcel Schuhen was helpless.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) has a shot blocked from inside the box.
43' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Marcel Schuhen, who smothers the ball.
40' The ball unexpectedly rebounds out to Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) on the edge of the box, but his attempt is lame and ends up well wide of the right post.
40' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
39' Bayern Munich are showing great team chemistry. They are passing the ball around seamlessly.
36' 1 - 1 Goal - 1:1! Harry Kane laid the ball off to Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich), who shot from close range into the bottom right corner, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
35' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) only has the keeper to beat after a fine cross from Joshua Kimmich, but he fluffs his lines from close in and sends the ball miles wide of the right post.
34' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 2:11.
32' Half-chance! Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) plays a pass into the box, but Marcel Schuhen reacts well to snuff out the attack.
32' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes miles wide of the right post.
31' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
30' Tobias Reichel has a clear sight and sees a foul from Thomas Poppler Isherwood (Darmstadt).

28' 1 - 0 GOAL! Superb work from Mathias Honsak, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Tim Skarke (Darmstadt), who beats Manuel Neuer with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
28' Christoph Klarer (Darmstadt) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
27' The game is interrupted now, Christoph Klarer (Darmstadt) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
26' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
23' Mathias Honsak (Darmstadt) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
23' Tobias Kempe (Darmstadt) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
22' Tobias Reichel blows the whistle, Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) is penalised for a foul.
20' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) fires a shot well wide of the left post from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
20' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
19' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) takes it short.
18' The resulting corner from Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) is cleared.
17' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
17' Bayern Munich force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
17' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
16' A pass into the box finds Mathias Honsak (Darmstadt) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the right side of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Manuel Neuer denies him.
15' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
14' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) does well to meet a cross from Raphael Guerreiro, but he directs his shot just wide of the left post.
14' Bayern Munich hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
11' Tobias Reichel blows his whistle and it's Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
9' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Marcel Schuhen intercepts the ball.
8' Matthijs de Ligt (Bayern Munich) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
8' Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

7' Marcel Schuhen was forced into action to thwart Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the right post but couldn't beat the keeper.
7' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
5' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) smashes the ball from the edge of the box and misses well wide of the left post.
3' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
